messages.author: d588a03e58ea7e7f
messages.subject: scale_continuous and missing set labels
parts:
I found a bug where the labels are not showing up when they are
directly set with a labels argument in a scale_continuous call.
Annotated example code below:

# drawing from example on http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/scale_discrete.html
d <- qplot(cut, clarity, data=subset(diamonds, carat > 1),
geom="jitter")

# known to give an error since breaks is now required with labels
# (but this example appears on web page documentation)
d + scale_x_discrete("Cut", labels=c("F","G","VG","P","I"))
# Error: Labels can only be specified in conjunction with breaks

# adding breaks argument
d + scale_x_discrete("Cut", labels=c("F","G","VG","P","I"),
breaks=1:5)
# generates a plot, but with NO labels on x axis

> sessionInfo()

messages.author: d588a03e58ea7e7f
messages.subject: Re: scale_continuous and missing set labels
parts:
Ah, right, of course. I was specifying the breaks wrong. I was
giving them in the coordinate space (1:5), not the original parameter
space (levels(diamonds$cut)). It is not a bug; it was a failure on my
part. Thanks for setting me straight.

--Brian Diggs
